title: Shop — Global Configuration
globalVatHint: This tax is automatically added to each order (if no product VAT). Manage in Taxes or select here.
globalTabHint: These rates apply based on the zone chosen by the customer at checkout. Use the Zones tab to enable/disable wilayas.
currencyHint: Type to filter (code, name or symbol). Default active currency is {code}. Managed in Currencies.
noCurrencyMatch: No matching currency. Check in Currencies or enter an ISO code (e.g. DZD, EUR).
hintCgv: Displayed in checkout (step 2) with mandatory checkbox.
hintDeliveryNotes: Reminder shown next to address and zone selection.
importHint: Configure a REST JSON source (array) or CSV. The system validates batches and quantities before import.
keyHint: Sent in header {header}. Leave empty if API is public.
validationCsv: CSV: header must contain name, price — quantities numeric
validationJson: JSON: each product requires name+price, quantity numeric
validationInvalid: Invalid products listed with line number
validationPersist: Real import then persists via your API/FS (data/products.json). Mapping adapts supplier fields (e.g. prix_ht → price).
zoneDeleteWarning: Deleting a zone also removes its rates from the Fees tab. Products already restricted to this zone will remain visible but will no longer be orderable for customers in this zone.
allZonesHint: Manage the full list of deliverable wilayas / countries. Uncheck “Active” to forbid sales, edit code/label/delay/COD, delete or duplicate.
currentTax: Current selection: {name} — will be automatically added at cart → order. To change the rate, edit the tax.
detailedTaxHint: Detailed taxes and coupons are configured in Taxes and Coupons. Product VAT (product sheet) has priority over global.
